I am an old woman, sixty years of age, farming my beans here in the North East. The land is our own, so I thank God for that, but money is not easy to find. I will put small manure from my goats and chickens because that one does not cost me anything, and beans themselves give life to the soil so plenty fertilizer is not needed. My children and grandchildren will help me with the weeding, but my back is not what it was, so I will call two or three people to help me at planting and harvest time.
